explication: UglifyJS is a JavaScript parsing, compression, mangling, and code-generation toolkit, exposed as both a programmatic API and a CLI. Its central workflow takes source text, parses it into an AST, optionally compresses and mangles it, then emits JavaScript and optionally a source map. The graph also preserves documented SpiderMonkey AST conversion and property mangling. Evidence is limited to the README and sampled excerpts; unsampled implementation links are omitted or marked unverified.
